Gold.note: Strong central bank buying and rate cut expectations support elevated prices.

Silver.note: Dual precious and industrial demand drivers alongside gold's momentum.

Copper.note: Tight concentrates market and robust electrification demand offsetting macro headwinds.

Uranium.note: Persistent structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity expansions.

Lithium.note: Continued EV battery oversupply and inventory destocking weighing on prices.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian NPI and MHP supply creating a persistent structural surplus.

Zinc.note: Tightening mine supply from recent closures supporting smelter treatment charges.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector demand capping upside despite steady seaborne supply.

Coal.note: Ample global seaborne supply and muted Asian demand growth limiting price upside.

Rare Earths.note: Strategic supply restrictions from China offsetting soft near-term EV motor demand.

Manganese.note: Steady steel production balancing emerging high-purity manganese battery demand.

PGM.note: Substitution by palladium in gasoline engines and weak auto production capping demand.

Potash.note: Tightening global inventories and resilient application rates supporting fertilizer demand.

Aluminum.note: Smelter capacity caps in China and strong green energy demand tightening the market.

Diversified.note: Broad exposure to copper and iron ore provides balanced upside with strong dividend yields.
